Subject: Hybrid webinar: studio playback schedule, simulcast handoff, and speaker release forms

Hi all,

We’re locking in the production plan for Kunde Health’s Nov 4 hybrid webinar (Zoom + ON24 simulcast). A few coordination items so we can finalize run-of-show and legal signoffs: 

1) Studio playback / pre-record handoff
- We’ll accept a single MP4 for the pre-recorded demo (max 18m). BrightWave, please confirm your ingest window for review and any encoding/transcode you’ll do.
- Encoder targets: we need RTMP endpoints for both the Zoom webinar RTMP and ON24 ingest. Laura, can you confirm the Zoom RTMP sink we’ll use? Ben, please attach the encoder baseline config that the studio should follow.

2) Speaker release & IP rights
- Kunde legal requires a signed speaker release for any pre-records and any recording used in marketing. I’ve created a DocuSign packet (link below). We need the signed release from Dr. Jane by Oct 10 to avoid legal hold.

3) Captioning and retention
- Auto-caption generated by platform is fine for the live stream, but Kunde requests an SRT file after the session. BrightWave, can you confirm caption export and who will deliver the SRT?

4) Playback test windows and timezone notes
- We’d like two full end-to-end playback tests: Oct 20 (US morning) and Oct 28 (US afternoon) to cover APAC overlap. Please send studio availability. Attachments: studio-availability.pdf (agency), encoder-config.txt (baseline).

Next steps: BrightWave, confirm availability and ingest endpoints this week. Laura/Ben, I’ll need the encoder config + Zoom RTMP by Sep 22 so we can run a mini dry-run. I’ll follow up with a short MOM after we confirm.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Growth Events Lead | Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

- RTMP endpoints: we’ll provide both target URLs and stream keys by Sep 20. We’ve reserved the encoder rack and will follow the encoder-config.txt you attached; small tweaks are documented in the included studio-availability.pdf.
